Strings.docker.error.manage_permission: Allow this app to manage Docker resources.
Strings.docker.error.read_permission: Allow this app to read Docker inventory.
Strings.docker.error.not_signed_in: You are not signed in to RelaxKonOS.
Strings.docker.proxy.title: Network proxy
Strings.docker.proxy.settings_managed_by_setting: Manage proxy configuration in Settings > Network. This page retains the effective Docker daemon, build-layer, and Docker Desktop status.
Strings.docker.proxy.subtitle: Configure an HTTP/HTTPS proxy for the Docker daemon (image pulls) and for builds. This applies to the whole server, not to a single user.
Strings.docker.proxy.source.managed: Use the built-in proxy (mihomo mixed port)
Strings.docker.proxy.http.label: HTTP proxy
Strings.docker.proxy.https.label: HTTPS proxy
Strings.docker.proxy.https.placeholder: Leave empty to reuse the HTTP proxy
Strings.docker.proxy.https.hint: When empty, HTTPS requests reuse the HTTP proxy address above.
Strings.docker.proxy.managed.available: The built-in proxy is listening and ready to use.
Strings.docker.proxy.managed.unavailable: The built-in proxy is not listening, so this source cannot be used. Start it in the Proxy app first.
Strings.docker.proxy.noproxy.label: Addresses that bypass the proxy
Strings.docker.proxy.scope.engine.hint: Writes the host Docker configuration: Docker Desktop restarts its application and a native Linux daemon restarts its service, so running containers are interrupted.
Strings.docker.proxy.scope.build.hint: Passed by the server as a build argument on docker build (the value travels in the child process environment, so it never appears on a command line). No host change and no restart. Two limits: an automatic build started by docker compose up does not receive it, and the address must be reachable from inside a build container - 127.0.0.1 there is the container itself, not the host.
Strings.docker.proxy.restart_warning: ⚠ Saving restarts the host's Docker, which interrupts running containers.
Strings.docker.proxy.desktop.title: Proxy Docker Desktop is using
Strings.docker.proxy.desktop.subtitle: Docker Desktop always points its daemon at its own internal proxy, so the daemon reports the internal relay rather than the real upstream. Below is the upstream Docker Desktop itself has stored: the proxy image pulls actually leave through.
Strings.docker.proxy.desktop.imported: Docker Desktop's proxy values were copied into the form; save to apply.
Strings.docker.proxy.confirm.restart: Saving restarts the Docker daemon: running containers will be interrupted and container services will be briefly unavailable. Continue?
Strings.docker.proxy.confirm.clear: Removing the proxy configuration also clears the host's Docker proxy settings and restarts Docker, interrupting running containers. Continue?
Strings.docker.proxy.status.load_failed: Could not read the proxy configuration: {0}
Strings.docker.proxy.status.save_failed: Could not save the proxy configuration: {0}
Strings.docker.proxy.layer.state.restart_require: Written; takes effect after Docker restarts
Strings.docker.proxy.detail.restart_pending: The host configuration is written; Docker must restart for it to take effect.
Strings.docker.proxy.detail.desktop_restart_pend: The setting is written, but the server could not start Docker Desktop; start it manually.
Strings.docker.proxy.detail.desktop_upstream_dif: Docker Desktop currently forwards to a different upstream proxy than the saved one.
Strings.docker.proxy.detail.build_only: Passed by the server as a build argument on docker build; no host change was made.
Strings.docker.proxy.detail.build_loopback_unrea: The build argument is in place, but the address names the host itself, which a build container cannot reach (127.0.0.1 inside a container is that container). Use an address the build container can reach, such as the host's LAN address.
Strings.docker.proxy.problem.stored_value_unread: The stored proxy credentials cannot be decrypted. Enter the proxy addresses again.
Strings.docker.proxy.problem.managed_proxy_unava: The built-in proxy is not listening, so this source cannot be used.
Strings.docker.proxy.problem.configuration_inval: The proxy address is invalid: an absolute http:// or https:// URL with no query or fragment is required.
Strings.docker.proxy.problem.confirmation_requir: This operation restarts Docker and requires confirmation.
Strings.docker.proxy.problem.platform_unsupporte: This host has no supported way to configure a Docker proxy.
Strings.docker.proxy.problem.helper_unavailable: The privileged helper is unavailable, so the host configuration cannot be written.
Strings.docker.proxy.problem.engine_apply_failed: Writing the host Docker proxy configuration failed.
Strings.docker.proxy.problem.engine_not_applied: The saved proxy has not been installed on the host yet. Save again and confirm.
Strings.docker.proxy.problem.desktop_settings_no: No Docker Desktop settings file was found.
Strings.docker.proxy.problem.desktop_settings_in: The Docker Desktop settings file is not valid JSON and was left untouched.
Strings.docker.proxy.problem.desktop_settings_un: The Docker Desktop settings file could not be read.
Strings.docker.proxy.problem.desktop_settings_lo: Docker Desktop holds its settings file open. Quit Docker Desktop and try again.
Strings.docker.proxy.problem.desktop_settings_de: The server account is not allowed to write the Docker Desktop settings file.
Strings.docker.proxy.problem.desktop_stop_failed: Docker Desktop could not be stopped, so the settings were not replaced.
Strings.docker.proxy.problem.desktop_settings_no: Docker Desktop did not keep the proxy value that was written.
Strings.docker.proxy.problem.daemon_unavailable: The proxy state could not be read from the Docker daemon.
Strings.docker.proxy.problem.request_failed: The server rejected the proxy request.
Strings.docker.engine.problem.confirmation_requi: The operation interrupts running containers, so it has to be confirmed first.
